_comment: Canonical description of the repository set. This file is the ONLY place the
list is written down. scripts/render_toolkit.py renders it into TOOLKIT.md
here and into the '## The set' table in each sibling repo's CONSUMING.md,
and scripts/verify_toolkit.py fails if any rendered copy has drifted.
It exists because the table was hand-maintained in six places and went stale
in all six at once: logi-report-kb was described as private and manually
refreshed for some time after it became public and got a weekly job.
'holds' is the short form used in CONSUMING.md. 'covers' is the longer form
used in TOOLKIT.md. They are separate fields because the two tables really do
say different things, and collapsing them would lose detail rather than

repos.name: logi-si-docs
repos.holds: Documentation mirror: SI, Composer v25 and v26, the legacy devnet archive, and the Composer OpenAPI specs
repos.covers: Documentation mirror: SI, Composer v25 and v26, the legacy devnet archive, the Composer OpenAPI specs

repos.name: composer-mcp
repos.holds: Composer REST API as MCP tools, with guards, plus the reference docs
repos.covers: Composer REST API as MCP tools, with guards. Reference docs for embedding, theming, chatbot, calculations, limitations, safety

repos.name: simba-intelligence-skill
repos.holds: SI install, configuration and troubleshooting skills
repos.covers: SI install, configuration, troubleshooting, NLQ testing, EDC connector testing, demo environments

repos.name: symphony-dashboard-builder-skill
repos.holds: Building Composer dashboards server side, and the client-side assembly around them
repos.covers: Composer dashboards: server-side creation and the client-side application around them

repos.name: logi-report-kb
repos.holds: Logi Report and JReport documentation and API surface
repos.covers: Logi Report and JReport: 13,235 documents plus the Server Web API surface
repos.refresh_note: but only the 3,891 current articles. The 9,344-article devnet archive is frozen because that host is dead, and `api/` needs a running instance CI cannot reach
